item: A record lock left with no owner record is taken over after a minute (row 172, R744)
summary: On the mkdir-lock path a lock directory with no pid file was never taken over, so every later launch row deferred to a child that waited for ever. A waiter now takes it over only when it has no pid file (an empty one never), the waiter has seen it so at every look for 60 s of its own clock (path and inode), the folder mtime is over a minute old (latched per inode), and a re-check under its mark now and a second later still finds none; then rename, delete and one line on stderr and in LOCK.cleared. Also fixes a set -u crash on the first look at a pid-less directory mark (since row 100). Release line: A launcher lock left without its owner record (for example after a crash at the wrong instant) is now taken over after a minute instead of blocking every later launch record.
